title: DualHeads: Reward-tilted few-step diffusion made simple
abstract: arXiv:2610.28858v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Distilled diffusion models generate high-quality images in a few sampling steps, but aligning them with task requirements and human preferences is difficult. Methods developed for multi-step diffusion models rely on differentiable rewards, or on score fields and stochastic trajectories that distilled generators may lack. We ask whether a few-step generator can be adapted using only external reward evaluations and reference samples, and show that two binary classifiers suffice. Our method, DualHeads, implements them as lightweight heads on a frozen diffusion backbone. The reward head learns which samples of the same prompt score higher, the reference head separates reference images from generated ones, and the generator maximizes a weighted sum of their logits. translated_title: DualHeads：简化的奖励倾斜少步扩散模型
translated_abstract: 蒸馏后的扩散模型能够以少量采样步骤生成高质量图像，但使其与任务需求和人类偏好对齐却十分困难。为多步扩散模型开发的方法依赖于可微奖励，或依赖于蒸馏生成器可能不具备的分数场和随机轨迹。我们探究是否可以仅使用外部奖励评估和参考样本来适配少步生成器，并证明两个二元分类器就足够了。我们的方法 DualHeads 将它们实现为冻结扩散主干上的轻量级头：奖励头学习同一提示词下哪些样本得分更高，参考头将参考图像与生成图像区分开来，而生成器则最大化两者 logits 的加权和。当这些头达到最优时，该目标等价于学习奖励的 KL 正则化最大化，且头权重的比值决定了正则化强度。
tldr: 提出 DualHeads 方法，通过在冻结的少步扩散模型上训练奖励头和参考头两个轻量级二元分类器，仅利用外部奖励评估和参考样本即可实现少步扩散模型的偏好对齐，且该目标等价于 KL 正则化的奖励最大化。
en_tdlr: DualHeads adapts few-step diffusion generators using only two lightweight binary classifier heads (a reward head and a reference head) on a frozen backbone, equivalent to KL-regularized reward maximization without requiring differentiable rewards or stochastic trajectories.
